description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street food cafe specializing in egg waffles (雞蛋仔), fish soup noodle combos, curry fish balls, and rice noodle rolls — popular street snacks brought from Hong Kong to Metro Vancouver. Located inside a mall food court, it offers an extensive menu with dozens of soup base, noodle, and topping combinations alongside a full range of bubble teas and fruit drinks. The cafe operates multiple locations including Aberdeen Centre, Public Market, and Park Royal.
